name: Gemini Client
description: Single-player utility / sandbox client for Minecraft 26.2: 250+ modules, a glassmorphic ClickGUI, a draggable HUD and built-in Baritone-style pathfinding. Server connections are blocked while it is installed.

custom.gemini:baritone: Hooks baritone.api.BaritoneAPI when present and ships a built-in 3D A* engine (#goto, #mine, #follow, #tunnel, #farm, #explore, #excavate, #sel, #thisway, #axis).
